setup.title: Set up your weekly post
setup.intro: Upload the blank version of the weekly schedule graphic you already make — the same design, with your own text boxes removed. HatchGrab fills in the week from your schedule.
setup.canvaTitle: How to export a blank from Canva
setup.canvaStep1: Open your usual weekly schedule design.
setup.canvaStep2: Delete the text boxes with the dates, places and times — leave the background and headings you want to keep.
setup.uploadHint: PNG or JPG, up to 10MB, at least {px}px on the short side.
setup.phoneTip: Best on a computer or iPad — the boxes are small to drag on a phone.
setup.pictureNote: Your picture without any date or place on it. We add those.
